channel.title: The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (occrp.org)

item.title: US Bars Palau Senate Leader Over Alleged China Ties
item.description: The U.S. barred the president of Palau’s Senate from entering the country over allegations he accepted bribes to promote the interests of China’s government and criminal figures.

item.title: Chinese Crypto Scam Fugitive With St. Kitts Passport Owns Dubai Property
item.description: Daren Li, who has fled a 20-year sentence for for his alleged role in stealing and laundering $73 million in Cambodia-based cryptocurrency scams, rents out a villa in Dubai

item.title: Brazil Charges Slain Paraguayan Congressman’s Son With Drug Trafficking
item.description: Alexandre Rodrigues Gomes, whose Paraguayan politician father was killed in a police raid, is accused of coordinating cocaine flights to Brazil. From there, Balkan crime groups allegedly shipped the drugs to Europe.

item.title: "Powerful" Epstein Accomplices Named by Congressmen Appear To Be Ordinary New Yorkers
item.description: Two crusading U.S. Congressmen, Ro Khanna and Thomas Massie, released the names of six men they claimed were "powerful" people tied to Epstein. But no clear evidence ties them to the disgraced financier and accused sex trafficker.

item.title: Explained: What Is The ‘Fake Dubai Prince’ Scam?
item.description: How fraudsters are posing as the real-life Crown Prince of Dubai to ensnare victims in their romance scams.

item.title: EU Honors Alexei Navalny; Labs Say He was Poisoned with Rare Neurotoxin
item.description: Diplomats in Geneva pay tribute to the Russian opposition leader as European laboratories claim he was poisoned with a dart frog neurotoxin

item.title: Ukraine Charges Ex Energy Minister with Money Laundering in ‘Operation Midas’ Case
item.description: NABU investigators allege the former energy minister used two shell companies to funnel millions in illicit funds to his family in Switzerland as part of the 'Operation Midas' probe.

item.title: Bank Documents Expose Scale of Secret Investments in Adani Group by Adani Family Associates
item.description: As the massive conglomerate faced allegations of market manipulation, two men who had close ties to the Adani family, including appearing as directors in affiliated companies, held billions in Adani stock.

item.title: Anti-Corruption Probe Launched Into Romanian Business Registry’s Failed IT System
item.description: Romania’s 38 million-euro business registry IT system, blocked for weeks in 2024 and now operating with intermittent failures, is under an anticorruption probe following audits revealing mismanagement and security lapses.

item.title: Cyprus Court Acquits Ex-Parliament President, MP in Golden Passport Case
item.description: Cyprus court clears ex-Parliament president, MP in a case linked to golden passports, citing missing witnesses and lack of evidence.
